definition.ave_err: standard error of the mean from the selected sub-bin contents (new default uncertainty)
definition.ave_err_from_bin_errors: old propagated mean error from the selected sub-bin bin errors
definition.avg: mean over all sub-bins in the nominal bin (optionally includes zeros)
definition.nominal_bin: sum of all sub-bin contents, with nominal error from quadrature of the sub-bin bin errors when available
definition.stddev_of_bin_contents: population standard deviation of the selected sub-bin contents
definition.weighted_ave_err: standard error of the mean from the selected sub-bin contents (new default uncertainty also used for the weighted average entry)
definition.weighted_ave_err_from_bin_errors: old inverse-variance weighted mean error from the selected sub-bin bin errors
